dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Treasure Hoarder booth!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Treasure Hoarders have a booth?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yep, every year. This is the largest legal black market in all of Teyvat. The stuff they dig up is perfect for a place like this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But can one person really represent their entire organization?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hah, no way! "Treasure Hoarder" is just a catch-all title. Their internal structure is crazy complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Thing is, the members who'd apply to set up the exhibits used to give themselves ever more high-falutin' titles. Y'know, to boost buyer confidence.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Over time, it became an unwritten rule that each expo can only have one "Treasure Hoarder booth."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The different factions usually duke it out beforehand for the right to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: To be honest, I see myself as a member of the Fruity Order first, and a Treasure Hoarder second.

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: Of course it does! The Fruity Order is known far and wide for its heroic deeds!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The Fruity Order's a familiar name around here, at least. They've been winning the Treasure Hoarder expo rights for a few years now. Although, this guy's a new face.
